data.name: Adonir
data.gender_notes: Adonir is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adonir is a Hebrew name derived from the word 'adonai', which means 'lord' or 'master'. In the Bible, God is often referred to as 'adonai', signifying His divine authority and sovereignty. The name Adonir symbolizes respect, submission, and devotion to God. The name Adonir carries the meaning “Lord, Master, Noble One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Adonir usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master, noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of reverence and submission to God.
data.etymology: Adonir belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, Master, Noble One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adonir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: עדוניר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עדוניר הוא שם נרדף לאדון, מלך, ראש, זמן, נשיא. זהו שם עברי שמקורו בשמות נאומן, עדי, ואוד. במסורת היהודית, שם זה קשור לגורל, תאריך ויכולת. במסורת הנוצרית, שם זה קשור לאדונותו של ישוע, המלך הנוצרי.

in_greek.name: Ἀδωνίρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἀδωνίρ ἐστὶ ὄνομα Ἑλληνικόν, ὅπερ προέρχεται ἀπὸ τῶν ὀνομάτων Νεούμαν, Ἄδη, καὶ Ὄδων. Συναφή ἐστὶν μετὰ τῆς Ἰουδαϊκῆς παράδοσιν, ὅπου ἐστὶ συνδεδεμένον μετὰ τὴν μοίραν, τὸν καιρόν, καὶ τὴν δύναμιν. Συναφή ἐστὶν καὶ μετὰ τὴν χριστιανικήν παράδοσιν, ὅπου ἐστὶ συνδεδεμένον μετὰ τὴν κυριαρχίαν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, τοῦ ἄρχοντος τῶν ἁγίων.

in_latin.name: Adonir
in_latin.long_meaning: Adonir est nomen Christianum, quod originem ducit a nominibus Neumanus, Adae, et Odon. In traditione Iudaeorum, nomen huius connexum est cum sorte, tempore, et potestate. In traditione Christiana, nomen huius connexum est cum dominatu Iesu Christi, principis sanctorum.

in_english.name: Adonir
in_english.meaning: lord, king, ruler, leader, supreme one
in_english.long_meaning: Adonir is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, specifically Adon or Adonai, meaning lord or ruler. The name is associated with the biblical concept of Adonai, the supreme God of the Israelites. In Christian tradition, Adonir is associated with Jesus Christ, the supreme ruler of heaven and earth. The name conveys a sense of authority, leadership, and divine guidance. People with this name are often seen as strong, confident, and visionary leaders.
